""" def build_post_html( topic_title: str, body_text: str, list_items: List[str] ) -> str: """ Build a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. Notes ----- * All user supplied content is escaped using `html.escape` to prevent injection of malicious HTML or JavaScript. * If ``list_items`` is empty, the unordered list section will be omitted entirely.       {''.join(safe_list_items)}
